summary.text: In June 2026, BEA Director Vipin Arora said BEA would release experimental statistics on the size of the American AI economy that year. Arora also said BEA had made significant progress estimating how AI production—through data center construction, algorithm development, energy use, and other activities—contributes to U.S. economic activity. He noted that official statistics have no unique “AI” industry because AI production is spread across sectors, and he described inputs such as servers, software developers, energy, semiconductors, and cloud services used to make and sell AI software.
